definitions.gloss: ear, nose, and throat department; ENT; otorhinolaryngology
definitions.explanation: The medical specialty dealing with conditions of the ear, nose, and throat, or the hospital department that handles these. Short for {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}.

examples.english: To go to the ENT department.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}がひどいので{耳鼻科|じびか}を{受診|じゅしん}した。
examples.english: I visited the ENT doctor because my hay fever was bad.

examples.japanese: {耳|みみ}の{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}いので、{近所|きんじょ}の{耳鼻科|じびか}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: My ear wasn't feeling right, so I made an appointment at a nearby ENT clinic.

notes:
Short for {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか} (otorhinolaryngology). In everyday Japanese, the abbreviated form {耳鼻科|じびか} is far more common. It covers conditions of the ears, nose, throat, and sinuses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳鼻科|じびか}に{行|い}く: to go to the ENT
- {耳鼻科|じびか}を{受診|じゅしん}する: to see an ENT doctor
- {耳鼻科|じびか}の{先生|せんせい}: ENT doctor
- {耳鼻科|じびか}{医|い}: ENT specialist

RELATED TERMS:
- {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}: the full formal name of the specialty
- {内科|ないか}: internal medicine
- {外科|げか}: surgery
- {眼科|がんか}: ophthalmology
- {皮膚科|ひふか}: dermatology
